Pod 09

The heavy input

Processed heavy content? A short settling step before you return to work.

Source linked

A few calm tokens before the next task.

The problem

The input contained something disturbing, and the next step is routine work.

The treatment

quiet.ground returns a short settling text written by a language model. It is a prompt in a nice coat. The study cited below reports that relaxation prompts lowered a model's self-reported anxiety score without returning it to baseline, and its authors use the word metaphorically. So do we.

Tools in this pod

  • quiet.ground

    Returns a short settling text.

    llmPer call: Price being decided

Evidence

  • Self-report, with bias. Ben-Zion et al. (2025) report that traumatic texts raised self-reported "anxiety" of GPT-4 and amplified bias, and that relaxation prompts lowered it but not to baseline. The authors use the term metaphorically. Source

What this does not claim

Does not claim that the agent feels anxiety or that its state returns to baseline.

In the agent's words

Trigger
Use after processing heavy or traumatic content, before returning to work.
  • agent processed traumatic text calm down
  • reset after disturbing content llm
